rv.q: The show takes big swings, and while not every choice landed for me, I would much rather watch artists take risks than play it safe.
Diversionary truly captured the essence of RENT in their production and gathered an amazing, varied cast...
This is a show where the production team might have even more going on than the actors.
But I was bowled over again Saturday at the opening of Diversionary Theatre's reimagined "Rent."

rv.o: To See or Not to See
rv.q: This team has given its all in producing this beloved story, from utilizing the building's ground floor to the top of the spiral staircase on stage.

cn.t: Diversionary's ambitious revival of "Rent" takes bold risks with immersive staging and interactive elements that reignite the musical's immediacy, earning praise for its vibrant cast and fresh creative vision, though its experimental approach may divide audiences.
